scientific_choices.rationale: Reuse qualified Text+Kernel control and unchanged paired radius3 Gap targets, frozen TRAIN1130/125, RGB512/native256 and BFS thresholds.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: No shared-feature interference or Text/Kernel parameter updates.

scientific_choices.rationale: Train only a new 65-parameter 1x1 head on cached frozen FP32 feature points without augmentation. All positive pixels retained; each negative stratum samples without replacement at most max(64, image positive count). Strata are positive Gap, valid non-Gap predicted text, remaining valid non-Gap background. Inverse sampled-class-count BCE gives each stratum equal total weight.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Test whether existing features support Gap separation with explicit class balancing; sampled priors need not yield calibrated probabilities and may overcut words.

scientific_choices.rationale: Predeclare 20 epochs Adam1e-3 without weight decay, seed202503, pixel batch16384, no LR or threshold search. Include epoch0; select native word F1, then fewer fused words, earliest epoch. OCR never selects the checkpoint.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Small diagnostic, not optimal full-dataset/augmentation training. Reused validation is exploratory.

scientific_choices.rationale: One pass frozen GPU feature extraction, sampled train vectors and full validation features cached on CPU/disk as FP32; head optimization and head inference on CUDA. Sequential PARSeq only after backbone release; record GPU, precision, shapes, allocated/reserved memory, OOM.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Avoid redundant backbone forwards over 20 probe epochs; no claim of end-to-end speed or RTX3070 fit.

scientific_choices.rationale: Frozen-feature separability, threshold calibration, joint adaptation after warmup and independent generalization remain to be measured.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Do not claim central AdaSpot reproduction or guaranteed benefit.
